result:
Perfect! I've successfully implemented the post revisions feature. Here's a summary of what was changed:

## Changes Made

### Database Schema
- Added `post_revisions` table to `db/schema.ts` with columns: `id`, `post_id`, `title`, `excerpt`, `body`, `created_at`
- Generated migration at `db/migrations/20260929194420_known_sprite/migration.sql`

### Models
- Created `app/Models/PostRevision.ts` - a new model for managing post revisions with proper relationships

### Controllers
- **`PostController.update()`** - Now saves the current post version as a revision before updating
- **`PostController.destroy()`** - Now deletes all revisions associated with a post before deleting the post
- **`PostController.revisions()`** - New method that renders a page showing all revisions for a post (newest first)
- **`PostController.restore()`** - New method that restores a previous revision and saves the current version as a new revision

### Routes & Validation
- Added `GET /posts/:id/revisions` - Renders revisions page (author-only)
- Added `POST /posts/:id/revisions/:revisionId/restore` - Restores a revision (author-only)
- Created `PostRevisionParamSchema` for validating both `id` and `revisionId` parameters
- Both routes are protected by the existing `PostPolicy` authorization (only the post's author can access)

### Frontend
- Created `resources/js/pages/posts/Revisions.tsx` - React component displaying revisions with restore buttons
- Auto-generated page types in `.guren/pages.gen.ts`

### Features Implemented
✓ Every successful edit keeps the previous version in `post_revisions`  
✓ Authors can view their post's revision history at `/posts/:id/revisions`  
✓ Authors can restore any previous revision (which creates a new revision of the current state)  
✓ Authorization is enforced - only the post author can access revisions  
✓ Wrong revision ID returns 404 (even for another author's revision)  
✓ Deleting a post cascades delete to all its revisions  

All tests pass: `bun run typecheck` ✓ and `bun test` ✓
